title: H4: refuse external commits while proposals are pending
description: RFC 9420 §12.4.3.2 forbids proposals by reference in an external Commit, so any external Commit would invalidate pending proposals. Readings: (A) refuse external Commits while any proposal is pending; (B) hub regenerates and staples proposals (§5.5; needs .4.9 + external Remove signing). Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: (A) now; (B) as a follow-up bead.
